messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "You too — have a great day.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z",
   "quote": "You too — have a great day.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-18T10:32:00Z",
   "quote": "Appreciate it. Looking forward to seeing how Keelwater handles our claims and supplier reporting needs.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T16:28:00Z",
   "quote": "Glad to hear it. We rely on clean claims and reporting, so this matters.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-29T16:20:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Appreciate you logging that. We handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, so eye comfort matters. Let me know if there’s a timeline or workaround.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T10:00:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Appreciate the quick response — just let me know if you need any login details or supplier IDs to troubleshoot.",
   "route": "support"
  }
 ],
 "title": "You too — have a great day."
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement is 'You too — have a great day,' which contains no product problem. The quotes are mostly pleasantries and closing remarks from sales conversations; none describes a product defect, feature request, or workaround. The support quote about late-night eye comfort hints at a dark-mode concern but is too vague to act on as stated.", "verdict": "fail"}
